name: cavemio-newsletter-footer
title: Newsletter footer
description: A footer that’s still alive: a signup that becomes its own confirmation, drawn link underlines and your name in outline.

cavemio.accessibility:
- A real form: Enter submits, the field has a label, autocomplete="email", and its helper and errors are attached and announced.
- Focus moves to the button once the confirmation replaces the field, and back into the field, selected, on "Wrong address?".
- The typo check is a small edit-distance match against common providers; it suggests, it never blocks.
- The wordmark is decoration: hidden from assistive tech and sized to fit with a ResizeObserver, in any font.
- Installs Number roll and Text morph. With reduced motion nothing slides or rises; states simply change.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: brand
props.description: – · Your name, mark and one line about you.

props.name: newsletter
props.description: – · onSubscribe(email) plus optional title, description, placeholder, buttonLabel and resendAfter (seconds, 30). Throw an Error to show its message.

props.name: columns
props.description: – · Link columns; a link takes href or onClick, and an optional badge.

props.name: legal
props.description: – · Small links in the bottom row, beside the copyright.

props.name: status
props.description: – · operational, degraded or outage, with an emerald, amber or red dot. The label morphs when the state changes.

props.name: socials
props.description: – · Icon links; the label is their accessible name.

props.name: wordmark
props.description: true · Your name in outline across the full width; a string to use other words, false for none.

features.title: It catches typos
features.description: An address like “gmial.com” shows “Did you mean …?” and fixes it in one click. It suggests and never blocks.

features.title: The signup becomes the confirmation
features.description: The field gives way to “Check your inbox”, and the button becomes “Resend in 0:30” with the seconds rolling down.

features.title: Errors in place
features.description: An invalid address shakes the box and says why. If onSubscribe throws, its message shows under the field.

features.title: Links, legal, socials and status
features.description: Link columns, small legal links, social icons and a status link with an emerald, amber or red dot.

features.title: Your name across the footer
features.description: The wordmark spans the full width in outline, and its letters fill wherever the pointer passes.

features.title: A real form
features.description: Enter submits, the field has a label and autocomplete="email", and its helper text and errors are announced.

states.title: typo
states.description: A domain one or two letters off a common provider shows "Did you mean ana@gmail.com?" under the field; the address is a button that fixes it.

states.title: invalid
states.description: The box shakes (380ms), its thin line turns red and the helper morphs to say why.

states.title: subscribing
states.description: A spinner opens in the button and its label morphs to "Subscribing" while onSubscribe runs.

states.title: sent
states.description: The field blurs out and "Check your inbox" blurs in with a check drawing itself; the button turns to a thin line "Resend in 0:30" and the seconds roll down. At zero it becomes "Resend".

states.title: failed
states.description: If onSubscribe throws, the field stays and its error message shows under it in red.

states.title: wordmark
states.description: Sized to span the footer exactly and cropped just below the baseline, so descenders sink into the edge. Letters rise out of that edge, 60ms apart (1000ms), the first time it’s in view. Hovered letters fill at once and fade back over 1.6s, so the pointer leaves a trail.
